input.newString:
setup(
    name="propscan",
    version="2.0.0",
    author="PropScan Contributors",
    author_email="propscan@example.com",
    description="High-performance Linux application that scans for proprietary software using intelligent license detection",
    long_description=long_description,
    long_description_content_type="text/markdown",
    url="https://github.com/propscan/propscan",
    packages=find_packages(where="src"),
    package_dir={"": "src"},
    classifiers=[
        "Development Status :: 5 - Production/Stable",
        "Intended Audience :: System Administrators",
        "Intended Audience :: Developers",
        "Intended Audience :: End Users/Desktop",
        "License :: OSI Approved :: MIT License",
        "Operating System :: POSIX :: Linux",
        "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
        "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.7",
        "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.8",
        "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.9",
        "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.10",
        "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.11",
        "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.12",
        "Topic :: System :: Systems Administration",
        "Topic :: Software Development :: Libraries :: Python Modules",
        "Topic :: Utilities",
    ],
    keywords="linux proprietary software license detection package-manager security audit",
    python_requires=">=3.7",
    install_requires=[
        "click>=8.0.0",
        "tabulate>=0.9.0",
        "colorama>=0.4.0",
    ],
    extras_require={
        "dev": [
            "pytest>=6.0.0",
            "coverage>=5.0.0",
            "black>=21.0.0",
            "flake8>=3.8.0",
            "mypy>=0.800",
        ],
        "test": [
            "pytest>=6.0.0",
            "coverage>=5.0.0",
        ],
    },
    entry_points={
        "console_scripts": [
            "propscan=propscan.cli:main",
        ],
    },
    package_data={
        "propscan": ["data/*.json"],
    },
    include_package_data=True,
    project_urls={
        "Bug Reports": "https://github.com/propscan/propscan/issues",
        "Source": "https://github.com/propscan/propscan",
        "Documentation": "https://github.com/propscan/propscan#readme",
    },
)
